stem: A leche flan recipe uses 10 egg yolks to make 2 llaneras. How many egg yolks are needed to make 5 llaneras?
hints: More llaneras need more yolks, at the same rate. Set up a proportion.
Keep the same order on both sides: yolks : llaneras = 10 : 2 = x : 5.

steps.action: Set up the proportion with the same order on both sides: 10 : 2 = x : 5.
steps.why: Yolks first, then llaneras, on both sides. Mixing up the order gives a wrong answer.
Shortcut check: one llanera needs 10 ÷ 2 = 5 yolks, and 5 llaneras need 5 × 5 = 25.

steps.action: 25 egg yolks are needed for 5 llaneras.

trapNotes.4: This pairs the numbers the wrong way (10 : x = 5 : 2) and works out 10 × 2 ÷ 5. More llaneras should need more yolks, not fewer.
trapNotes.13: This adds: 5 is 3 more than 2, so 10 + 3 = 13. In a proportion the amounts are multiplied, not added.
trapNotes.50: This is 10 × 5. You still need to divide by 2, because 10 yolks make 2 llaneras, not 1.
